detail.body:
## Purpose Porting some of ATOMs optimizations to vLLM Container: `vllm/vllm-openai:rocm:nightly` Targeted changes: 1) _attn_res_kernel + add_rmsnorm_quant_kernel -> fused 2) _causal_conv1d_fwd_kernel for qkv -> _causal_conv1d_fwd_kernel fused into one kerenel (aiter support) 3) native sigmoid + native mul -> fused _sigmoid_mul_kernel (aiter support) ## Test Plan lm_eval used for accuracy, bench serve used for performance ``` lm_eval \ --model local-completions \ --model_args "model=/data/Kimi-K3/,base_url=http://localhost:8002/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=None,trust_remote_code=True" \ --tasks gsm8k \ --num_fewshot 5 \ --seed 42 \ --output_path /app/lm_eval_out --log_samples ``` Server command: ``` #!/bin/bash export PYTHONPATH=/app/vllm-src${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH} export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 export SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU=1 # export AITER_SITUV2_A8W4=1 export AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0 export VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=0 vllm serve /data/Kimi-K3/ \ --port "${K3_PORT:-8002}" \ --trust-remote-code \ --moe-backend auto \ --tensor-parallel-size 8 \ --load-format auto \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \ --mm-encoder-tp-mode data \ --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \ --enable-auto-tool-choice \ --tool-call-parser kimi_k3 \ --reasoning-parser kimi_k3 \ --max-num-seqs 128 --enable-prefix-caching \ --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","custom_ops":["+fused_rms_norm_gated"]}' \ # --profiler-config '{"profiler":"torch","torch_profiler_dir":"/app/traces","torch_profiler_with_stack":false}' \ ``` Bench command: ``` vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model /data/Kimi-K3/ \ --host localhost --port "${K3_PORT:-8002}" --endpoint /v1/completions \ --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --request-rate=inf --random-prefix-len 0 \ --num-prompts CONC*10 --max-concurrency 16/64 --ignore-eos --trust-remote-code \ # --profile ``` ## Test Result Accuracy: |Tasks|Version| Filter |n-shot| Metric | |Value | |Stderr| |-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:| |gsm8k| 3|flexible-extract| 5|exact_match|↑ |0.9629|± |0.0052| | | |strict-match | 5|exact_match|↑ |0.9629|± |0.0052| Perf (all changes put together): ---

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops.causal_conv1d import causal_conv1d_fn
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import NULL_BLOCK_ID
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="AITER fused conv1d is ROCm-only"
+)
+
+WIDTH = 4  # Kimi-K3 short_conv_kernel_size
+STATE_LEN = WIDTH - 1
+HEAD_DIM = 128
+LOCAL_HEADS = 4  # per-TP-rank heads; projection = 512, packed dim = 1536
+
+
+def _fused_fn():
+    gdn = pytest.importorskip("aiter.ops.triton.gated_delta_net")
+    return gdn.causal_conv1d_split_qkv_triton_tile_fn
+
+
+def _make_inputs(seqlens, has_initial_state, seed=0, device="cuda"):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    proj = HEAD_DIM * LOCAL_HEADS
+    dim = 3 * proj
+    total = sum(seqlens)
+    n_seqs = len(seqlens)
+    # Token-major activations, as produced by the in_proj GEMM.
+    mixed_qkv = torch.randn(total, dim, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    weight = torch.randn(dim, WIDTH, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device) * 0.3
+    # More cache lines than sequences, assigned in a shuffled order. Line 0 is
+    # vLLM's null block (NULL_BLOCK_ID), which causal_conv1d_fn skips, so real
+    # sequences never map to it.
+    n_lines = n_seqs + 2
+    conv_state = torch.randn(
+        n_lines, dim, STATE_LEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device
+    )
+    cache_indices = (torch.randperm(n_lines - 1, device=device)[:n_seqs] + 1).to(
+        torch.int32
+    )
+    query_start_loc = torch.tensor(
+        [0] + list(torch.tensor(seqlens).cumsum(0).tolist()),
+        dtype=torch.int32,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    has_initial = torch.full(
+        (n_seqs,), has_initial_state, dtype=torch.bool, device=device
+    )
+    return mixed_qkv, weight, conv_state, cache_indices, query_start_loc, has_initial
+
+
+def _reference(
+    mixed_qkv, weight, conv_state, cache_indices, query_start_loc, has_initial
+):
+    """fp32 per-sequence depthwise causal conv + SiLU.
+
+    Returns (out[T, dim], new_conv_state).
+    """
+    x = mixed_qkv.float().t()  # (dim, T)
+    w = weight.float()
+    dim = x.shape[0]
+    out = torch.empty_like(x)
+    new_state = conv_state.float().clone()
+    qsl = query_start_loc.tolist()
+    for s in range(len(qsl) - 1):
+        start, end = qsl[s], qsl[s + 1]
+        ci = int(cache_indices[s])
+        xs = x[:, start:end]
+        if bool(has_initial[s]):
+            xin = torch.cat([conv_state[ci].float(), xs], dim=1)
+        else:
+            xin = F.pad(xs, (STATE_LEN, 0))
+        y = F.conv1d(xin.unsqueeze(0), w.unsqueeze(1), None, groups=dim)[0]
+        out[:, start:end] = F.silu(y)
+        new_state[ci] = xin[:, -STATE_LEN:]
+    return out.t(), new_state
+
+
+def _three_launch(
+    mixed_qkv, weight, conv_state, cache_indices, query_start_loc, has_initial
+):
+    """The pre-fusion KDA prefill path: one causal_conv1d_fn per projection."""
+    proj = mixed_qkv.shape[1] // 3
+    outs = []
+    for x, state, w in zip(
+        mixed_qkv.split(proj, dim=-1),
+        conv_state.split(proj, dim=-2),
+        weight.split(proj, dim=0),
+    ):
+        outs.append(
+            causal_conv1d_fn(
+                x.transpose(0, 1),
+                w,
+                None,
+                activation="silu",
+                conv_states=state,
+                has_initial_state=has_initial,
+                cache_indices=cache_indices,
+                query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+            ).transpose(0, 1)
+        )
+    return outs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "seqlens", [[1024], [8, 1, 300], [64, 64, 64], [513, 64, 1, 1200]]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("has_initial_state", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("block_m", [8, 128])
+def test_fused_split_qkv_conv1d_matches_reference(seqlens, has_initial_state, block_m):
+    fused_fn = _fused_fn()
+    mixed_qkv, weight, conv_state, cache_indices, qsl, has_initial = _make_inputs(
+        seqlens, has_initial_state
+    )
+    proj = mixed_qkv.shape[1] // 3
+
+    ref_out, ref_state = _reference(
+        mixed_qkv, weight, conv_state, cache_indices, qsl, has_initial
+    )
+
+    state_3 = conv_state.clone()
+    q3, k3, v3 = _three_launch(
+        mixed_qkv, weight, state_3, cache_indices, qsl, has_initial
+    )
+
+    state_f = conv_state.clone()
+    # Exactly the call made by KimiK3DeltaAttention._forward.
+    qf, kf, vf = fused_fn(
+        mixed_qkv.transpose(0, 1),
+        weight,
+        None,
+        state_f,
+        qsl,
+        proj,
+        proj,
+        cache_indices=cache_indices,
+        has_initial_state=has_initial,
+        activation="silu",
+        block_m=block_m,
+        metadata=None,
+        preserve_input_dtype=True,
+    )
+
+    fused = torch.cat([qf, kf, vf], dim=-1)
+    assert fused.shape == mixed_qkv.shape and fused.dtype == mixed_qkv.dtype
+    assert all(t.is_contiguous() for t in (qf, kf, vf))
+
+    tol = dict(atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(fused.float(), ref_out, **tol)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(fused, torch.cat([q3, k3, v3], dim=-1), **tol)
+
+    # conv_state writeback: assigned lines updated, the others untouched.
+    torch.testing.assert_close(state_f.float(), ref_state, **tol)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(state_f, state_3, **tol)
+    untouched = torch.ones(conv_state.shape[0], dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda")
+    untouched[cache_indices.long()] = False
+    assert untouched[NULL_BLOCK_ID]
+    assert torch.equal(state_f[untouched], conv_state[untouched])

I think the direction for new models is to make aiter/amd specific changes under vendor specific files `vllm/models/kimi_k3/amd/mla.py`. the amd/mla.py does not currently exists but I have this PR https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52494 that contributes that file and incorporates the Q and KV rmsnorm fusion.

no in general we will really shy away from ENV vars in this case.  We'd want to pick one or the other.    We do have another PR that is moving the KDA's MLA over closer to kimi.  https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52494  Maybe after this move, we have more wiggle room?
Sure we can hold off until #52494 is merged...
